items.t: Authored laws expanding newborn screening, including AB 395 (2011), AB 1559 (2014) and SB 1095 (2016) (2016).
items.q: expanding California’s Newborn Screening Program to save lives by adding screening for Severe Combined Immunodeficiency Disorder (AB 395, 2011) and Adrenoleukodystrophy (AB 1559, 2014), and then requiring the Department of Public Health to expand screening of newborns
